scope: All retained November 1 expansion intake, including held sources; original baseline records are not reappraised.
method: Deterministic primary-text terms route possible system comparisons. Each comparison references baseline_capabilities by id for its existing equivalent, incremental question, bounded next check and pinned artifacts. Matches do not demonstrate novelty, methodological quality, independent corroboration or operational benefit.

baseline_capabilities.existing: The checkpoint tool records explicit authority and binds release approval to an exact head. The inspected manifest retains its original authority block; dynamic revocation and universal downstream enforcement are not demonstrated.
baseline_capabilities.question: Does the source add a check at a boundary our control record only describes?
baseline_capabilities.experiment: Use a synthetic delegated task, revoke its scope, then check that stale context and downstream tools cannot act under the old permission; compare with the current checkpoint-only baseline.

baseline_capabilities.existing: Portable memory/context machinery and correction-oriented evaluation. These are mechanisms and design principles, not proof of correction survival or tool authority enforcement. The checkpoint manifest can omit old active items under its byte cap without an omitted-active count.
baseline_capabilities.question: Does the source improve retrieval or update behavior without losing source versions, correction survival or access boundaries?
baseline_capabilities.experiment: Compare the existing memory fixture with a bounded source-inspired variant on changed facts, superseded facts, abstention and one cross-task isolation case; retain failures, latency and token burden.

baseline_capabilities.existing: Governed replay selects episodes for offline memory review and validates proposals through an adopter-supplied simulator; it does not replay an intervened trajectory or undo external effects. Checkpoints retain bounded state and release evidence.
baseline_capabilities.question: Does this provide a better failure drill or attribution method than our current evidence replay?
baseline_capabilities.experiment: Inject a lost acknowledgment, duplicate retry and stale owner into a fictional handoff; compare recovery correctness and duplicate effects, using deterministic outcome checks before any model judge.

baseline_capabilities.existing: Published best-baseline method separates orientation, handoff, correction, ownership, recovery, outcome and burden.
baseline_capabilities.question: Does it supply executable checks or better measurement that the existing method leaves to an adopter?
baseline_capabilities.experiment: Run the same synthetic work item through the existing harness and a minimal source-inspired check; compare false passes, missed failures, judge disagreement and total review burden rather than using a composite quality score.

baseline_capabilities.existing: StaleToast pins source identities/digests and preserves immutable chart/export history; Breadcrumbs carries bounded evidence pointers.
baseline_capabilities.question: Does it expose a source-to-result or row-level change that hashes and counts alone miss?
baseline_capabilities.experiment: Compare two fictional catalog revisions containing a duplicate, changed denominator and stale source link; require an inspectable diff and exact affected IDs while preserving both versions.

baseline_capabilities.existing: Bounded resource accounting and separate quality/time/review measures; list-price estimates are not actual charges.
baseline_capabilities.question: Can it reduce observed work or inspection cost without trading away correctness or authority?
baseline_capabilities.experiment: Hold the task, model and acceptance criteria fixed; compare observed tokens, elapsed time, rework and human inspection effort, recording funding classification separately.

baseline_capabilities.existing: Portable handoff/checkpoint contracts and manual setup checks; naming a provider or agent is not proof of execution coverage.
baseline_capabilities.question: Does it normalize useful evidence across tools without overcollecting private content or equating traces with authenticated completion?
baseline_capabilities.experiment: Translate one fictional run from two harness formats into a common receipt, with missing model identity and a failed tool call; verify loss visibility, redaction boundaries and an explicit unknown state.
